title: A tracked new part always keeps a default bin in the window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test location has at least two bin locations, so a second bin can be added.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Try to remove the only bin row.
  3. Click Add Bin Location.
  4. Pick a second bin location in the new row.
  5. Click Default on the second row.
  6. Try to remove the row marked Default.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens with the switch on and one bin row already filled in: the location's default bin, Quantity 0, marked Default.

Step 2:

  • The only bin row stays: it cannot be removed.

Step 3:

  • A second, empty bin row appears.

Step 4:

  • The second row shows the bin location you picked.

Step 5:

  • One of the two rows is marked Default, never neither of them.

Step 6:

  • The row marked Default stays: both rows are still there.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R7: “When the switch is on, at least one bin location must be set, and one must be marked as the default, before the part can be saved.”
  • Story 4, context note: “Context note: in the dialog a new part always starts with the location's default bin, and the last bin and the default bin cannot be removed, so S4-N1 and S4-N2 come from requests made outside the dialog.”
